title: Norwegian Keto Beef Stir Fry
description: A keto beef stir fry with a tangy and savory flavor, perfect for a quick dinner. This recipe serves 4 and can be ready in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef slices and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped rocket lettuce to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and pour in the Norwegian stir-fry sauce, velvety mayonnaise, and tangy soy sauce.
Stir everything together and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
